feedback.observed: Several successive turnover fixes improved empty time, endpoint distance, footprint clearance, and bridge speed, but the user still had to identify that the continuous carrier path communicated the wrong identity story.
feedback.expected: For an identity or continuity complaint, inspect the actor lifecycle and adjacent rendered frames before optimizing another coordinate metric; test what story the uninterrupted trajectory communicates.
feedback.evidence: V21, v25, and v26 passed their numeric turnover checks, yet the v26 source still reused one field-slot actor and moved the UFO directly from the outgoing pickup to the incoming drop. The first diagnosis that traced both facts produced the bounded service-cut correction.
feedback.reproduction: For the next actor-identity motion report, require a source lifecycle trace plus pickup-to-next-action frame sequence before proposing a spatial or timing change.

feedback.observed: Opening sheep still appeared to swoosh in from outside at deployment, while a replacement could read as the same collected sheep being set down elsewhere. The first attempted correction hid the UFO completely, but the intended teleport-like feeling was a very fast visible flight followed by an arrival flash.
feedback.expected: Materialize every sheep at its exact destination, keep the UFO physically visible during a brief speed flight, and separate outgoing-full from incoming-hungry identity without another asset, badge, or effect layer.
feedback.evidence: Source tracing found a 10px pre-drop sheep descent and no deterministic equality check between spawn and ready transforms. Fresh adjacent 700px frames of the corrected candidate show opening sheep 3 and 4 absent until exact-drop materialization; all 22 exchanges show five visible UFO positions across 0.104 playback seconds, the existing travel streak and arrival light, a preflight INBOUND 0/20 panel handoff, and a clean white compressed replacement revealed only at the remote drop.
feedback.reproduction: Run npm run visual:fixture and npm run check, then inspect adjacent 700px frames for opening sheep 3 and 4 plus the first, maximum-distance, and final exchanges; reject any off-drop sheep reveal, UFO opacity cut, coordinate teleport, sheep visible in flight, delayed incoming identity, or missing arrival response.

proposals.change_target: opening sheep materialization, turnover flight duration and acting, incoming identity contrast, deterministic SVG checks, README behavior description, and durable motion guardrails
proposals.cause: Opening sheep began from a vertical offset before their exact drop, while the replacement reused the same field-slot art without a strong lifecycle contrast. A pure opacity cut overcorrected the requested speed sensation by removing physical travel entirely.
proposals.candidate_change: Remove the pre-drop sheep offset, require identical exact-cell spawn and ready transforms, compress each visible pickup-to-drop UFO flight to 0.104 playback seconds, reuse the existing travel streak and arrival light, and reset the incoming actor to clean white zero energy with a compressed in-place reveal under the stopped UFO.
proposals.discovery_evidence: The accepted source used a 10px sheep descent and lacked an exact spawn-anchor assertion. The candidate's first exchange renders the UFO at five physical positions from 7.020 through 7.124 seconds, switches the panel to SHEEP 07 INBOUND 0/20 before travel, reveals no sheep in flight, then materializes the replacement only at the drop from 7.280 through 7.358 seconds.
proposals.reproduction: Run npm run visual:fixture and npm run check; inspect fresh 700px forced-theme adjacent opening, first/later/final exchange, reduced-motion, bridge, roster, finale, and terminal frames.
proposals.primary_metric: Every opening and replacement sheep reveal is anchored to its exact drop, and all 22 turnover UFO flights remain physically visible for exactly 0.104 playback seconds with an arrival flash while the outgoing and incoming roster identities remain distinct.
proposals.prediction: Exact-cell materialization plus a short visible carrier burst will remove the outside-swoosh defect and retain speed, while zero-energy in-place replacement acting will communicate a different sheep without adding visual clutter.
proposals.falsification_condition: Reject if an opening or replacement sheep appears outside its drop, any UFO opacity cut or coordinate teleport remains, the fast flight lacks visible intermediate frames or arrival response, the incoming sheep appears in flight or retains outgoing energy, any accepted causal or layout check regresses, runtime exceeds 50 seconds, or npm run check fails.
proposals.regression_check: npm run check plus a fresh exact-time 700px Gate across opening, multiple exchanges, incoming landing, bridge, reduced motion, finale, terminal, and 10/28/62 rosters in both themes.
proposals.transfer_check: Not applicable; this is a project-scoped motion correction.
